method.to_date: reconstructed from box scores (Yahoo's week 3 totals could not be read: unreadable makes/attempts value '/')
method.rebuild: a day with Yahoo's pinned lineup counts its active slots (not BN, IL or IL+); any other day counts every non-IL player on today's roster who played, ten per day by the daily-fill rule when more played; each day's source is in rebuild_rosters
method.projection: season-pool per-game line x each remaining game x today's status availability; ten-slot daily fill; IL counts 0
method.percentages: total makes / total attempts, actual plus projected
method.drop: no game left this week and board value below the active roster's median
method.chances: P(win) per category: the normal approximation on the final totals; to date fixed, the remaining games' variance from the season per-game CV (FG%/FT%: binomial makes x PCT_MIX_INFL^2); the shared weekly shock left out
method.this_week: each free agent in place of the below-median player whose drop helps most, from tomorrow; ranked by the change in expected categories won (the sum of the nine changes in P(win)); season cost = the change in expected weekly categories against the other eleven teams
method.pickups: Yahoo's available-player list (100 listed, Yahoo-wide ownership order), each from today on at his Yahoo letter's availability, ranked by projected category wins gained, then gap closed
